answer: Neighbor-quorum bond: an identity claims a reef plot and locks 65 credits. Seven neighbors each stake 25 credits on an ivory seal. Each epoch a lantern beacon spot-checks a tenth of plots; holders re-show seals in an hour. A missing seal, or one from a rented-seal ring, burns bond and stakes. Forging 1,000 costs 7,000 seals at 25 plus 1,000 bonds: 240,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 65 credits once and keeps its full share.
